strategy_decisions.statement: Select MAP_TO_L03_OPI_FOUNDATIONAL_INTERROGATIVE_FIRST as the next curriculum-mapping route.
Keep future mapping limited to VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE only.
Do not map to STR001/STR002 or STR003-STR005 in this strategy.

Preserve no subject/person, tense/aspect or copula inference and no KE generalization.
If approved, open only a separate exact L03 OPI curriculum-mapping gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Strategy approval is not curriculum mapping or OPI authoring/validation.
Strategy approval does not unlock QA/STR003-STR005.
Strategy approval does not activate runtime.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
